name: smith narrow row
description: A row with a narrow grip on the smith machine, pulling toward the torso. It works the mid back and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Set the smith bar at about knee height and stand close to it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the bar with your hands close together.
Unrack the bar and let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
